item.summary: Ubuntu 26.04 sanity test_17i: FAIL: error not detected

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment: xiwang Please take a look.

using strace to analysis the system call, and we can see

on Rocky9's client, ls invokes readlink, and returns ERPOTO as expected

futex(0x7fec6dbfba8c, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
statx(AT_FDCWD, "/mnt/lustre/test_17i_dir/testlink", AT_STATX_SYNC_AS_STAT|AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW|AT_NO_AUTOMOUNT, STATX_MODE|STATX_NLINK|STATX_UID|STATX_GID|STATX_MTIME|STATX_SIZE, {stx_mask=STATX_MODE|STATX_NLINK|STATX_UID|STATX_GID|STATX_MTIME|STATX_SIZE|STATX_MNT_ID, stx_attributes=0, stx_mode=S_IFLNK|0777, stx_size=33, ...}) = 0
lgetxattr("/mnt/lustre/test_17i_dir/testlink", "security.selinux", "unconfined_u:object_r:unlabeled_"..., 255) = 37
access("/var/run/setrans/.setrans-unix", F_OK) = -1 ENOENT (没有那个文件或目录)
futex(0x7fec6dc8a520, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, 2147483647) = 0
readlink("/mnt/lustre/test_17i_dir/testlink", 0x55ce6be7d1c0, 34) = -1 EPROTO (协议错误)

while on Ubuntu26‘s client, ls first invokes listxattr, which consumed EPROTO error,

and return ok when it really calls readlink.

listxattr("/mnt/lustre/test_17i_dir/testlink", 0x7ffcd8062e50, 4096) = -1 EPROTO (Protocol error)
listxattr("/mnt/lustre/test_17i_dir/testlink", 0x7ffcd8062f60, 4096) = -1 ENOENT (No such file or directory)
......
readlink("/etc/localtime", "/usr/share/zoneinfo/Asia/Shangha"..., 256) = 33

So, it may be an easy way to replace "ls -l" with "readlink" in sanity.sh test_17i?

"Xiyang Wang <xiwang@ddn.com>" uploaded a new patch: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/66695
Subject: LU-20362 tests: replace "ls -l" with "readlink" in test_17i
